intro: Discover Fuengirola on Spain’s Costa del Sol: sandy beaches, the seafront promenade, Los Boliches, Sohail Castle, markets and easy day trips to Málaga, Mijas and Benalmádena. Plan your holiday and save memories and photos on your device.

areas.name: Fuengirola Town Centre
areas.description: Explore Plaza de la Constitución, shops, cafés and the historic centre.

areas.name: Los Boliches
areas.description: Lively coastal neighbourhood with restaurants, shops and its own train station.

areas.name: Carvajal
areas.description: Eastern coastal area with beaches and restaurants.

areas.name: Torreblanca
areas.description: Residential and beach area with a C1 train stop.

areas.name: Los Pacos
areas.description: Neighbourhood inland from Los Boliches with local cafés and services.

areas.name: Miramar / Sohail Castle
areas.description: Western side of Fuengirola near the castle, river and shopping centre.

areas.name: Paseo Marítimo Rey de España
areas.description: Long beachfront promenade linking several neighbourhoods and beaches.

attractions.name: Castillo Sohail
attractions.description: Historic hilltop castle overlooking the coast; check event access and opening times.

attractions.name: Bioparc Fuengirola
attractions.description: Zoo with immersive habitats; check tickets and current opening hours.

attractions.name: Plaza de la Constitución
attractions.description: Central square and meeting point with shops and cafés.

attractions.name: Puerto Deportivo
attractions.description: Marina area with boat trips and seafront restaurants; verify operators.

attractions.name: Parque Fluvial
attractions.description: Riverside park near Sohail Castle with walking routes.

attractions.name: Yacimiento Romano Finca del Secretario
attractions.description: Roman archaeological site; check visitor access before travelling.

transport.name: Málaga Airport
transport.description: Málaga–Costa del Sol Airport is the nearest major airport; check transport connections.

transport.name: Cercanías C1 train
transport.description: Train links Fuengirola, Los Boliches, Torreblanca and Carvajal with Málaga Airport and Málaga city; check Renfe timetables.

transport.name: Local buses
transport.description: Check current routes for Mijas, nearby neighbourhoods and surrounding towns.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: The seafront promenade is generally level; some inland streets are steeper.

transport.name: Taxis
transport.description: Use licensed taxis and confirm pickup points and fares.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Useful for inland villages and longer day trips; parking may be limited in summer.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check bank and card charges.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check current UK government Spain travel advice and passport requirements.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Spanish is the official language; English is widely spoken in tourist areas.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow beach flags, lifeguard advice and weather warnings.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Mainland Spain is generally one hour ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Sun protection
useful.description: Carry drinking water, sunscreen and a hat, especially in summer.

beaches.name: Playa de Fuengirola

beaches.name: Playa de Carvajal

beaches.name: Playa del Castillo

markets.name: Town centre shopping

nightlife.name: Marina area
